period_note: Solo/Separate basis, chosen per the project's preference for Solo over Consolidated -- this filing prints BOTH a Consolidated set of statements (Group, i.e. NRB Bank PLC and its subsidiary NRB Bank Securities PLC) AND a Separate/Bank-only set, laid out as a compact single-page 'newspaper' composite (top half = Consolidated Balance Sheet/P&L/Cash Flow/Equity, bottom half = plain 'Balance Sheet'/'Profit and Loss Account'/'Cash Flow Statement'/'Statement of Changes in Equity' with no 'Consolidated' prefix = the Separate/Bank-only figures) -- resolved by page-image rendering (pdftoppm) since pdftotext's column ordering merges the two halves in a confusing interleaved order. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2024 (column headed '01 January to 31 March 2024'); the source ALSO separately prints a discrete quarter-only column for Q1 (identical to the cumulative column since Q1 is the year's first quarter). EPS is labelled plain 'Earnings per share (EPS)(Restated)' -- NOT annualized, a convention change from the 2016/2017 vintage filings (verified: 15,405,607 / 690,587,200 weighted-avg shares != 0.02 exactly due to weighted-average-share mechanics from the Jan/Feb-2024 IPO diluting mid-quarter, but is clearly NOT x4-annualized, consistent with the plain '(Restated)' label). Solo Balance Sheet identity verified exactly (Total Liabilities 78,656,560,794 + Total Shareholders' Equity 9,157,034,016 = Total Assets 87,813,594,810). The Statement of Changes in Equity independently confirms: Retained earnings 1,027,872,348 (1-Jan-2024) + Net profit after tax 15,405,607 = 1,043,277,955 (31-Mar-2024 closing), matching the Balance Sheet exactly; Paid-up capital increased from 5,905,872,000 to 6,905,872,000 via a 1,000,000,000 Initial Public Offering (IPO) during the quarter (the bank listed on DSE/CSE in February 2024). This is the first quarter for which NRB Bank's own unaudited interim filings are found on its website -- consistent with the bank's IPO/listing date (prospectus vetted 28 Dec 2023, subscription 28 Jan-1 Feb 2024, listed ~27 Feb 2024): before listing, the bank had no BSEC obligation to publish interim financials publicly, which is the genuine structural reason no earlier (2018-2023) interim filings could be found on the bank's site or via the Wayback Machine (confirmed via a full-domain Wayback CDX search) despite the bank continuously existing since 2013 -- see sources.json for the full research trail.
